response.rationale: Four T1 meta-analyses (Li 2010, Lyster 2010, Russell 2006, Hattie 2007) plus T2 and T3 studies show corrective feedback has medium-to-large, durable positive effects, but the one negative item (Wisniewski 2020) carries the same text as Hattie and says about 32% of feedback effects are negative, so the effect depends on feedback type; it also doesn't test "predicts proficiency" directly, and the Hattie and Wisniewski entries look duplicated.
